path.title: Path
path.description: Pattern specifying log files to monitor. Supports wildcards and multiple patterns separated by commas.

tag.title: Tag
tag.description: Tag for log records. Supports regex extract fields and asterisk expansion (replaced with file path).

exclude_path.title: Exclude Path
exclude_path.description: Shell patterns separated by commas to exclude files (e.g., *.gz,*.zip).

buffer_chunk_size.title: Buffer Chunk Size
buffer_chunk_size.description: Initial buffer size to read file data.

buffer_max_size.title: Buffer Max Size
buffer_max_size.description: Maximum buffer size per monitored file. Files exceeding this are removed from monitoring.

mem_buf_limit.title: Memory Buffer Limit
mem_buf_limit.description: Memory limit for appending data to the engine. Plugin pauses when limit is reached.

read_from_head.title: Read From Head
read_from_head.description: For new files at startup, read from the beginning instead of the end.

refresh_interval.title: Refresh Interval
refresh_interval.description: Interval in seconds for refreshing the list of watched files.

rotate_wait.title: Rotate Wait
rotate_wait.description: Extra seconds to monitor a rotated file for pending data.

skip_long_lines.title: Skip Long Lines
skip_long_lines.description: Skip lines exceeding buffer capacity instead of stopping file monitoring.

exit_on_eof.title: Exit On EOF
exit_on_eof.description: Exit when reaching end of file. Used for bulk load and tests.

ignore_older.title: Ignore Older
ignore_older.description: Ignore files older than this value. Supports m, h, d syntax (e.g., 5m, 1h, 2d).

ignore_active_older_files.title: Ignore Active Older Files
ignore_active_older_files.description: Ignore files older than ignore_older even if being ingested.

db.title: Database File
db.description: SQLite database file to track file offsets. Enables state persistence across restarts.

db.compare_filename.title: DB Compare Filename
db.compare_filename.description: Review both inode and filename when retrieving stored file info from database.

db.journal_mode.title: DB Journal Mode
db.journal_mode.description: SQLite journal mode. WAL provides higher performance but isn't compatible with network filesystems.

db.locking.title: DB Locking
db.locking.description: Restrict database access to Fluent Bit only for improved performance.

db.sync.title: DB Sync Mode
db.sync.description: SQLite synchronization method. Full mode has high I/O cost.

parser.title: Parser
parser.description: Parser name to interpret log entries as structured messages.

key.title: Key
key.description: Key name for unstructured messages (when no parser applied).

path_key.title: Path Key
path_key.description: If set, appends monitored file path to records using this key name.

offset_key.title: Offset Key
offset_key.description: If set, appends file offset to records using this key name.

tag_regex.title: Tag Regex
tag_regex.description: Regular expression to extract fields from filename for tag construction.

docker_mode.title: Docker Mode
docker_mode.description: Recombine split Docker log lines. Cannot be used with Multiline.

docker_mode_flush.title: Docker Mode Flush
docker_mode_flush.description: Seconds to wait before flushing queued split Docker lines.

docker_mode_parser.title: Docker Mode Parser
docker_mode_parser.description: Optional parser for the first line in Docker multiline mode.

multiline.parser.title: Multiline Parser
multiline.parser.description: Multiline parser definitions (comma-separated). Use 'docker, cri' for container logs.

multiline.title: Multiline (Legacy)
multiline.description: Enable legacy multiline mode. Cannot be used with docker_mode.

multiline_flush.title: Multiline Flush
multiline_flush.description: Seconds to wait before processing queued multiline messages.

parser_firstline.title: Parser Firstline
parser_firstline.description: Parser matching the beginning of multiline messages. Required when multiline is on.

inotify_watcher.title: Inotify Watcher
inotify_watcher.description: Use inotify for file watching. Set false to use file stat watcher instead.

file_cache_advise.title: File Cache Advise
file_cache_advise.description: Use posix_fadvise to reduce kernel file cache usage (Linux only).

static_batch_size.title: Static Batch Size
static_batch_size.description: Maximum bytes to process per iteration for static files (existing at startup).

event_batch_size.title: Event Batch Size
event_batch_size.description: Maximum bytes to process per iteration for event-monitored files.

progress_check_interval_nsec.title: Progress Check Interval Nanoseconds
progress_check_interval_nsec.description: Nanosecond component for sub-second precision on progress checks.

watcher_interval.title: Watcher Interval
watcher_interval.description: Interval for symbolic link rotation monitoring.

unicode.encoding.title: Unicode Encoding
unicode.encoding.description: Unicode encoding for file data. Requires simdutf library with C++11+.

generic.encoding.title: Generic Encoding
generic.encoding.description: Non-Unicode encoding for file data conversion to UTF-8.

threaded.title: Threaded
threaded.description: Run this input plugin in its own thread.
